title.narrative: 2024 reflects a;year of collaboration, innovation, and impact, driven by its commitment to act as a backbone support structure for India’s youth development and empowerment ecosystem. By fostering partnerships across public, private and civil society sectors and amplifying the voices of young people, YuWaah has facilitated transformative change, reaching nearly 29 million young individuals and enabling opportunities in critical areas such as skilling, career guidance, employment, entrepreneurship, mental health, climate action and youth centrality. Additionally, we leveraged USD 3.89 Million in financial resources to support these transformative initiatives, underscoring our commitment to creating impact for and with youth.;
